title: A jsdom focus-return test must first focus the element being activated
rule: When a component test asserts that focus returns somewhere (the grid, a trigger button) after a control is clicked, first call `.focus()` on that control and assert it is `document.activeElement`. `trigger('click')` does not move focus in jsdom and `document.body.focus()` is a no-op, so an element that was already focused stays focused and the test passes even with the refocus code removed. Check that the test fails without the refocus call.
rationale: E50.9 (#580): the popover close-button test passed without `grid.focus()` in `closeDetail`, because the cell click had already focused the grid.
